description: Default architecture, no weight assignment (random init, expected ~0% accuracy).

4-layer hand-built circuit, no LayerNorm: MLP0 forms digit-place products, attention 1 averages them over the 10 input digits, MLP1 computes per-place sum/generate/propagate, MLP2 resolves each carry as the generate bit of the nearest lower non-9 place, MLP3 outputs (a+b+carry) mod 10 for the current output position.

2-layer hand-built circuit, no LayerNorm: 10 single-key attention heads gather a_r and b_r for each place, MLP0 computes per-place sum/generate/propagate, MLP1 outputs (a_p+b_p+carry) mod 10 where carry = generate bit of the nearest lower place whose sum is not 9 (full lookahead).

2-layer hand-built circuit (no LayerNorm): 10 single-key attention heads gather a_r, b_r per place; MLP0 computes per-place sum/generate/non-9 features; MLP1 outputs (a_p+b_p+carry) mod 10, carry = generate bit of nearest lower non-9 place within window 0. Knobs: d_model=380, d_ff=512, layers=2, attn_sharpness=30.
